cover_teasers: Terapanth's 267th Foundation Day Observed Under Acharya Mahashraman
Neminath's Moksha, Janma & Diksha Kalyanak Observed
Hindu-Jain Temple of Monroeville Marks 40th Anniversary

editors_note: This edition covers Q3 2026 to date (July 1 – August 18). As a Jain Foundation publication, its scope is the full breadth of genuine Jain community news — spiritual and devotional life alongside civic, business, and leadership news — not spiritual events alone. The only hard content restriction is on cruelty or violence, or content that even touches on animal harm/poaching topics. Every headline is dated and sourced from a trusted outlet. Where no verifiable news was found for a section, it is left honestly empty rather than filled. Note: sourcing this cycle skewed heavily India-based (roughly 85% India / 15% overseas against an 80/20 target) — no item was invented or dropped to force the ratio.

items.headline: Terapanth's 267th Foundation Day Observed Under Acharya Mahashraman
items.body: The Jain Śvetāmbara Terapanth Dharmasangh observed its 267th Foundation Day on Ashadhi Purnima, presided over by its 11th Acharya, Mahashraman — his first major discourse of this year's Chaturmas. Themed "Terapanth Will Endure Forever," the occasion was simultaneously marked at Terapanth centers nationwide, including at Sri Dungargarh, where senior sadhvi Lakshyaprabha addressed a separate gathering on the theme of self-awakening and the order's founding ideals — a reminder that the observance reached beyond Ladnun into the wider Terapanth monastic and lay community on the same day.
items.source: Free Press Journal, Sri Dungargarh Times

items.headline: Karera's Mohanlal Jain Takes Muni Diksha in Agra
items.body: Mohanlal Jain, a resident of Karera in Shivpuri district, Madhya Pradesh, renounced worldly life at a large Jaineshwari Diksha Mahotsav held in Agra, following a series of community farewell (vairagya) programs in his hometown.

items.headline: Lord Neminath's Moksha Kalyanak Observed Nationwide
items.body: Jain temples in Jaipur and Firozabad held special worship marking the Moksha Kalyanak (liberation anniversary) of Neminath, the 22nd Tirthankar, as pilgrims also gathered at Girnar itself — revered as the site of his diksha, omniscience, and moksha.

items.headline: Lord Neminath's Janma & Diksha (Tap) Kalyanak Observed
items.body: Per the Jain calendar, Shravan Shukla Panchami and Shukla Shashthi mark Neminath's Janma Kalyanak (birth anniversary) and Diksha/Tap Kalyanak (renunciation anniversary) respectively — traditionally observed at Sahasavan near Mount Girnar, his site of renunciation.
items.source: Jain Tithi Panchang (Samyakdarshan.org, Sus Jain Mandir Calendar)

items.headline: Gyan Ganga Mahotsav Begins Under Acharya Pulaksagar Maharaj
items.body: A multi-day public religious-discourse festival opened under Acharya Pulaksagar Maharaj, a prominent Digambar Jain acharya, during his Chaturmas stay in Bhilwara — with daily morning discourses running through August 30.

items.headline: 'White Stripe' Road-Marking Dispute Flares Again
items.body: Chemical markings painted on Daftari Road to guide barefoot Jain monks and nuns through Malad East were defaced by MNS workers with "public objection" graffiti and later repainted by the BMC — the latest flashpoint in Mumbai's recurring dispute over religious accommodations on public roads.

items.headline: Acharya Vardhamana Sagara Maharaj Attains Samadhi After Sallekhana
items.body: Digambara Acharya Vardhamana Sagara Maharaj, of the spiritual lineage of Acharya Shantisagara Maharaj, passed away at Kunthalgiri Siddhakshetra following a 13-day fast undertaken under the Jain vow of Sallekhana (Samadhi Marana), with monks and devotees gathering from across India for the final rites.

items.headline: Muni Samvegaratna Sagar Ji's Chaturmas Mangal Pravesh With Shobhayatra
items.body: The Sri Jain Shvetambar Murtipoojak Sangh organized a procession (shobhayatra) from Sri Rishabdev Temple to Sri Gnanvallabh Upashraya in Vivekanand Nagar, welcoming Muni Samvegaratna Sagar Ji and his monastic group for their Chaturmas stay with chants, kalash, and dharma flags carried through the streets.

items.headline: Muni Aagam Sagar Ji's Mangal Pravesh Marks Bada Mandir's First Chaturmas in 18 Years
items.body: Muni 108 Shri Aagam Sagar Ji Maharaj entered Raipur's historic Shri Digambar Jain Bada Mandir — the temple's first Chaturmas hosting in 18 years, drawing large community turnout.

items.headline: Gurudev Rameshmuniji Arrives in Mysuru After ~90,000-km Padayatra
items.body: Gurudev Shri Rameshmuniji Maharaj Saheb, National Minister of the Shraman Sangh, began his Chaturmas stay at Shri Sthanakvasi Jain Sangh, Mahaveernagar, following a decades-spanning foot pilgrimage across India and Nepal.

items.headline: Muni Sudhasagar Ji Maharaj Addresses Jain Youth During Indore Chaturmas
items.body: Muni Sudhasagar Ji Maharaj, in Indore for Chaturmas since July 26, delivered a special guidance address to Jain youth at Rishabh Sabha Hall, Adinath Jinalaya.

items.headline: A Confluence of Devotion and Patriotism at SS Jain Sabha
items.body: During ongoing Chaturmas, the community held a joint Independence Day and Hariyali Teej celebration, blending devotional and patriotic programming.

items.headline: Shri Shantinath Temple's Pratishtha Mahotsav Held in Avanti Nagar
items.body: A consecration festival (Pratishtha Mahotsav) was held for the newly built Shri Shantinath Temple at Aviradh Park, Avanti Nagar.

items.headline: Yaksha-Yakshi Pratishtha & Vasatika Foundation-Laying Announced
items.body: A mahotsav announced for August 30 will install Yaksha-Yakshi deities and lay the foundation for a new pilgrim rest house ("Vasatika") at Sri Adinath Digambar Jain Temple.

items.headline: Hindu-Jain Temple of Monroeville Marks 40th Anniversary With Re-Inauguration Ceremony
items.body: The joint Hindu-Jain temple — the first of its kind globally, where Hindus and both Shwetambar and Digambar Jains worship together — held a Shikhar Puja and re-inauguration ceremony marking 40 years since its 1984 founding, with its five domes ritually consecrated.

items.headline: World Jain Organisation Renews Demands Over Sammed Shikharji Security
items.body: Renewed calls for a complete motorbike ban on the hill, removal of illegal encroachments, and additional CCTV coverage to protect the tirth's sanctity and security.

items.headline: Muni Pramansagar Ji's Sangh Completes Charan Vandana of Sammed Shikharji
items.body: Digambar Jain Muni Pramansagar Ji Maharaj and his monastic sangh completed a foot-pilgrimage veneration circuit of the sacred Sammed Shikharji hill, followed the next day by a "mangal milan" with the viharing sangh of Acharya Sambhavsagar Ji Maharaj at the same tirth.

items.headline: Sadhvi Mani Prabha's Mandal Completes Vihar Into Begun
items.body: A group of Jain sadhvis led by Sadhvi Mani Prabha walked a multi-day route from Sukh Shanti Nagar to Begun town, ahead of their formal Chaturmas entry ceremony.

items.headline: Global Immersion Summer School Draws Scholars from 12+ Countries to Jain Vishva Bharati
items.body: Nearly 40 students and scholars from more than a dozen countries attended a three-week "Jain Way of Life" program covering Jain philosophy, Prakrit/Sanskrit, and Preksha meditation, engaging directly with Acharya Mahashraman and Terapanth monastics.

items.headline: JITO USA Launches New Miami Chapter
items.body: The Jain International Trade Organisation's US arm launched a Miami initiative — a hybrid in-person and video gathering connecting the local Jain business community with JITO leadership in India. 21 founding members took the JITO oath at the launch, hosted at Florida International University.

items.headline: Houston's Swatantra Jain Named 2026 Sangh Seva Puraskar Recipient
items.body: Swatantra Jain, founder and chairman of Jain Vishwa Bharati–Houston, was announced as recipient of the Sangh Seva Puraskar 2026 — conferred by Jain Vishwa Bharati, Ladnun — recognising decades of institution-building and service to the diaspora Jain community.

items.headline: Business Families Bid Up to ₹53 Crore for the Honor of Installing the Ceremonial Kalash
items.body: Ahead of Muni Sudhasagar Ji's four-month Chaturmas stay in Indore, trading and business families placed devotional bids — a traditional boli practice — to install the mangal kalash, with total bids across the community reaching ₹53 crore. The top individual bid, ₹16.16 crore, was shared by Sapna Manish Godha and Naveen Anand Godha, securing the first kalash. Senior Acharya Sunil Sagar Maharaj publicly urged that such offerings should serve devotion rather than become a display of wealth, prompting community reflection on the scale of the bidding.

items.headline: Bangalore Blasters Unveiled for Inaugural JITO Premier League
items.body: Navrathan Jewellers and Jain Sports Group jointly launched the "Bangalore Blasters" cricket franchise for JITO Premier League Season 1, with cricket legend Kapil Dev attending, ahead of the tournament in Colombo (Aug 24–Sept 5).

items.headline: 'Mangal Milan' of Jain Monks Carries a Message of Non-Violence
items.body: A devotional gathering in Chitrakoot marked the meeting (mangal milan) of Jain munis, centered on a shared message of ahimsa (non-violence) for the community — a reminder of the principle that runs through Jain teaching, delivered as visiting monastic groups crossed paths in the town.

items.headline: Rashtrahit Vichar Goshthi evam Samman Samaroh
items.body: A discussion forum on national interest paired with a felicitation ceremony honoring distinguished Jain community members across professional fields — chartered accountants, doctors, lawyers, professors, engineers, and government officials.

items.headline: Young Jains of America Holds 17th Biennial Convention
items.body: More than 800 Jain youth from across North America and abroad gathered for YJA's four-day convention, themed "The Art of the In-Between," exploring Jain values alongside contemporary life through workshops, speakers, and cultural programming.
